fields.description: Mode of Payment recorded when the cashier takes cash.
fields.label: Cash

fields.description: Created by the installer if it does not already exist.
fields.label: M-Pesa

fields.description: Customer sends to a phone number. Leave blank to book it against the generic M-Pesa mode above.
fields.label: M-Pesa · Send Money

fields.description: Customer pays a business paybill and account number. Leave blank to fall back to M-Pesa.
fields.label: M-Pesa · Paybill

fields.description: Cash taken over the agent counter against an M-Pesa withdrawal. Leave blank to fall back to M-Pesa.
fields.label: M-Pesa · Withdraw

fields.description: Price list the till sells at. Defaults to the standard selling list.
fields.label: Selling Price List
Post Material Requests to WhatsApp Group

fields.description: Group JID from the WhatsApp bridge, e.g. 120363012345678901@g.us. Not a phone number.
fields.label: Staff Group JID

fields.description: Print Format the attached PDF is rendered with. Leave blank to use whatever ERPNext prints a Material Request with by default.
fields.label: Material Request Print Format

fields.description: Optional. Which connected WhatsApp number sends the message.
fields.label: Sender

fields.description: Tell the customer on WhatsApp when a sale of theirs is reversed, so a refund is never a surprise on their statement.
fields.label: Notify Customers of Sales Reversals

fields.description: The message posted with the PDF. Jinja, rendered against the request as doc — {{ doc.name }}, {{ operator }}, {{ customer }}, {{ items }}, {{ link }}. Leave blank for the built-in wording.
fields.label: Material Request Message Template

fields.description: Message the customer and the manager when a delivery is dispatched.
fields.label: Notify on Dispatch

fields.description: Phone number or group JID that gets a copy of every dispatch notice. A number, not a name.
fields.label: Manager WhatsApp

fields.description: Print Format for the slip that goes on the carton. Leave blank to use the app's own delivery label.
fields.label: Delivery Label Print Format

fields.description: Dispatch message. Jinja, rendered against the delivery as doc — {{ doc.name }}, {{ customer }}, {{ rider }}, {{ rider_phone }}, {{ address }}. Leave blank for the built-in wording.
fields.label: Dispatch Message Template

fields.description: Suppliers in this group are offered at the till when an item is out of stock. Created and set by the installer.
fields.label: Neighbour Supplier Group

fields.description: Warehouse goods bought from a neighbour are received into before being sold.
fields.label: Sourcing Warehouse

fields.description: Where cash taken out of the drawer for a non-sales expense is booked. Falls back to the company's default expense account.
fields.label: Default Expense Account

fields.description: Where a shortfall nobody is named for is written off. The part a person is named for goes to the Short Account on their POS Profile instead.
fields.label: Unattributed Short Account

fields.description: Refuse to complete a sale unless the cashier has an open shift. Leave off in a shop that does not run shifts — a till that cannot sell is worse than one that reconciles nowhere.
fields.label: Require an Open Shift to Sell

fields.description: Show each product's photo on the till's item grid. A shop whose staff recognise the packaging faster than the name wants this on; a shop with no photos loaded gains nothing but a slower grid.
fields.label: Show Item Photos on the Till
